One sparse checkout of data/final gets all of it
description: ECTSum (EMNLP 2022) is a supervised summarisation corpus: 2,425 US earnings-call transcripts (one sentence per line, prepared remarks only in the samples seen) paired with short Reuters-wire-style bullet summaries (1-14 bullets, e.g. 'q4 adjusted loss per share $0.10', 'system-wide comparable revpar decreased 59.2 percent'). Grain is one call (ticker x fiscal quarter), fiscal 2019Q3-2022Q4, 354 tickers in the test split alone, mostly mid/large-cap US names, no ABNB but HLT, H, DRH, MTN present. Source is the authors' repo (transcripts originally from The Motley Fool, summaries from Reuters). For ABNB an analyst would use it as a labelled train/eval set for a guide-item and KPI extractor over ABNB and peer (BKNG/EXPE/HLT/MAR) calls, or to benchmark an LLM summariser against wire-style gold before running it on the 5 Nov call.
issues: Licence: repo is GPL-3.0 (code), but the underlying transcripts are Motley Fool text and the summaries are Reuters wire text, redistributed by the authors without an explicit data licence; treat as research-use only and do not commit derived text into the pitch repo. Sample plan expected 132 KB for the 495 summaries; actual is ~150 KB (fine). 505 files were pulled because the plan sanctioned the whole 132 KB summary directory; transcripts limited to 10. No ABNB calls; only 4 lodging-adjacent tickers in test. Last push 22 May 2024 (job card said Mar 2023). Filenames give fiscal period only, no call date or CIK, so joining to prices needs a ticker/quarter-to-date map.
